provenance.correction_scope: A1 layered VES forward kernel (scientific), A2/A3 finite-volume face transmissibility (rounding level for uniform meshes)
provenance.artifact_is_curated: This file is the curated M21 evidence record. It is not a byte-for-byte dump of M21QualificationReport.to_json(), which nests manifest/convergence blocks.
provenance.closure_verification: The M23 closure increment (C1 percentage-RMS numeric domain, C2 forward-factorization failure phase) was verified against this file: outcome, initial_objective, final_objective, metrics and manifest hashes are identical to a fresh run. This record stores no rms_percent and no failure phase, so neither correction can reach it. See docs/m23_evidence/probe_m23_closure.json.

corrections.reason: M22 corrected the 3D ERT reporting defect: the engine returned an objective history and convergence flag describing the pre-update model rather than the returned model, so the recorded final objective wrongly equalled the initial objective and hid a measured objective reduction. Manifest hashes, metrics, and all vector and VES records are unchanged.

M23 corrected the layered VES forward-model kernel (A1). The previous correction integral carried a spurious 1/r factor, which mis-scaled every layered response and left the fit truncated at max_nfev. With the corrected kernel the same bounded fit satisfies the scipy termination criteria at 13 function evaluations. This is a change of the scientific forward model, not of the optimizer, tolerance, or fixture.

Same A1 kernel correction: the apparent-resistivity responses, and therefore the log-space residual of the returned layered model, changed. The new value is measured against the unchanged internal fixture and noisy observations.

Same A1 kernel correction. The absolute rmse decreased because the corrected three-layer responses have a smaller absolute spread across the Schlumberger spacings; relative and log10 metrics stay of the same order. No threshold is asserted by any of these metrics.

M23 replaced the face transmissibility with the exact series-resistance form (A3). For an equal-width mesh the two forms are algebraically identical but not bit-identical, so these values differ at floating-point rounding level (relative change below 1e-13). No discretization, fixture, or optimizer behavior changed.

Same A2/A3 assembly rewrite at rounding level: the uniform 3D fixture mesh has no unequal-width faces, so only floating-point association changed (relative change below 1e-15). Nonuniform meshes, which were affected scientifically, are covered by the M23 regression tests.

external_benchmark.reason: No legally usable independent dataset with trustworthy expected results is available in the repository.

limitations: Internal synthetic evidence is not an independent benchmark.
Residual and convergence behavior do not establish geological certainty or uniqueness.
Topography-aware inversion and uncertainty/resolution analysis are not implemented.
M15 physical LS2 validation remains pending and the ABEM importer remains NOT_READY.
The M23 corrections changed VES forward-model values; only the corrected values above are current.
